rules.content:
title: TAE Infrastructure Rotation Detection
status: experimental
description: Detect Threat Actor Ecosystem (TAE) infrastructure rotation patterns used by bulletproof hosting providers to evade sanctions and takedowns: (1) IP prefix transfers between related Autonomous Systems 
logsource:
    product: network
    category: routing_analytics
    service: bgp_monitoring
detection:
    selection_prefix_transfer:
        prefix_transfer_days|lt: 30
        source_asn_related: true
        destination_asn_related: true
    selection_new_org:
        new_organization_age_days|lt: 90
        ripe_resource_allocation: true
        organization_verification_status: "minimal"
    selection_threat_density:
        threat_density_score|gt: 0.6
        prefix_announcement_age_days|lt: 14
        historical_abuse_on_prefix: false
    selection_rebranding:
        asn_name_change_days|lt: 60
        infrastructure_overlap_score|gt: 0.7
    condition: (selection_prefix_transfer and selection_new_org) or selection_threat_density or (selection_prefix_transfer and selection_rebranding)
level: high
rules.title: DL-0123: TAE Infrastructure Rotation Detection (Sigma)
